# Dilan Kochhar

> Web developer, AI engineer, and SEO/AEO specialist in Tampa, FL. Designs and builds websites, apps, and AI agents solo, and runs a $500/month Search & AI Visibility retainer (technical SEO, on-page optimization, structured data, answer-engine optimization, monthly reporting). Also offers website care plans: security $45/month, maintenance $80/month, or both as Full Care for $100/month. Website builds start at $1,000. Founder of Dilly (hellodilly.com), a career platform for college students.
